instructions.text: TextEdit may first display a file dialog. Choose New Document there, or File > New when a document window is open. Begin writing in the document body.
To open a document, use File > Open, select the intended file, and choose Open. Verify the document identity before changing its contents.
TextEdit saves edits automatically. File > Save lets you set the document name and location; verify both in the save dialog before confirming.
Use Format > Make Plain Text for text without styling, or Make Rich Text when formatting is needed. Converting to plain text removes formatting; choose the format required by the task.
While an Open or Save dialog is active, its filename and search fields are not the document body. Finish the dialog, then obtain a fresh observation before writing document content.
